title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: Linear independence means that no column in the design matrix can be written as a combination of the others. This ensures that each feature contributes uniquely to the model.

title: Unique Solutions in OLS
text: In an OLS model, if the columns of the design matrix are linearly independent, it means that the matrix is full rank. This is crucial for ensuring a unique solution.

title: Checking for Linear Independence
text: Which of the following statements is true about a matrix with linearly independent columns?
choices: The matrix is not full rank.

title: OLS and Full Rank
text: When the design matrix is full rank, it means that the inverse of the matrix can be computed, which is necessary for finding the unique OLS solution.
